name: Edmonton
scopeLimits: Official Edmonton documentation identifies province/partners as the distributor of cadastral/title geometry for land within the municipal boundary, and the public City ArcGIS service exposes a Title Parcels polygon layer. Metadata review verified a polygon layer, native OBJECTID, and query support; a bounded point query and sibling Legal Parcels metadata request each returned HTTP 403. No alternate host, credentials, or headers were tried. No geometry or exact-point feature was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The City of Edmonton’s official parcel-mapping notice states that Alberta Data Partnerships and AltaLIS maintain/distribute cadastral and title mapping within the Edmonton municipal boundary. The City ArcGIS Property Lines service exposes a Title Parcels polygon layer whose metadata extent covers the WUP point, but exact point geometry was not retrieved.
technicalBlocker: Standard anonymous ArcGIS query GET and POST to the Title Parcels layer returned HTTP 403. The Legal Parcels child-layer metadata path also returned HTTP 403. No access challenge was bypassed.
remainingUncertainty: The current Title Parcels feature contents at the exact WUP locator, the public licensing/redistribution terms for returned polygons, Legal Parcels schema, and source pagination behavior at the point remain unverified.
nextStep: Root review; verify a safe, bounded city-specific geometry service and exact WUP locator coverage before any runtime qualification.

officialSources.observation: The City states that ADP and AltaLIS maintain/distribute cadastral and title mapping for parcels within Edmonton municipal boundaries.
City notice says polygon parcel open-data datasets were retired from its catalog in 2021; replacement open-data layers are centroids only.

Current ArcGIS child layer metadata identifies Title Parcels as a polygon layer, native OBJECTID, EPSG:3776 source reference, EPSG:3857 metadata extent, and JSON/GeoJSON query formats. Schema includes address and other descriptive fields; only OBJECTID and geometry were selected in the attempted safe query.
Official public SLIM map provides legal-description, zoning, and assessment lookup tools; the city-hosted Property Lines group includes Title Parcels and Legal Parcels sublayers.
City describes distribution of mapping products through its open-data portal, Map Desk, and Alberta Data Partnerships.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: The City-hosted Title Parcels layer provides a plausible public polygon-source candidate, but the bounded safe-field query returned 403, so no feature geometry or exact locator coverage is verified.
